thread:
yara: Quick riff on dark-mode theming for diff/code + metrics panels. Noticed a few things in the diff view: added lines (green) look too saturated next to the warm error series in charts, and small inline token counts in the heatmap get lost. Thought: introduce distinct semantic tokens for diffs vs chart states and add numeric overlays for compact heatmap cells.

ben: can you paste your suggested vars? i'm especially curious about the error/added/removed token colors.

yara: pasted minimal vars below (experiment):
```
--bg: #0b0e11; /* page */
--panel: #111316; /* cards */
--muted: #9aa3a9; /* secondary text */
--accent: #58bfff; /* brand */
--diff-add: #7be3b0; /* code diff add */
--diff-rem: #ff9aa2; /* code diff remove */
--chart-info: #7bd2ff; /* info series */
--chart-warn: #ffd57a; /* mid */
--chart-err: #ff6b6b; /* error series, desaturated for dark */
--heat-high: #ff7a66; --heat-mid: #ffd77f; --heat-low: #4fb6aa;
--heat-overlay-alpha: 0.88; /* numeric overlay alpha for tiny cells */
```

opal: love the semantic separation. two quick accessibility points: 1) diff-add vs heat-low are similar for protanopes; keep diff-add more bluish or add a faint icon + numeric overlay, 2) tiny heatmap cells must include either a numeric microcopy or a high-contrast stroke for the top quartile.

priya: accessibility checks: small numeric labels need 4.5:1 against --heat-overlay-alpha background. If cells are <10px we need a numeric overlay only on hover or an accessible tooltip for keyboard users. Also ensure focusable cells have a visible 3:1 focus ring.

ben: UX nit: for diffs we should avoid warm greens that look like success badges. Use a slightly cool add color so it doesn't semantically clash with 'success' in other contexts. e.g., make --diff-add -> #5fd1c4 and keep --chart-err desaturated so errors still pop but don't fight code tokens.

yara: updated suggestion: `--diff-add: #5fd1c4; --diff-rem: #ff9aa2; --chart-err: #ff6b6b (desat)` and approach for heatmap: add optional numeric overlay controlled by setting "Heatmap: Values" (off / on / on-hover). Tooltip copy: "Show numeric values for small cells (useful for precise inspection and accessibility)."

opal: pattern fallback idea: for compact dashboards enable a 1px outline on cells in top/bottom deciles so shape conveys magnitude even if hue is ambiguous. That plus numeric overlay on hover should be robust.

priya: keyboard interaction: cells should be focusable with Enter to open the tooltip; tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and announce value via aria-live if changed. Also document that color-only encodings are supplemented by text/patterns. Add this to the a11y checklist.

ben: copy tweak for settings: replace "Color-blind mode" with two toggles: "Heatmap values" and "Heatmap patterns (accessibility)". For diffs: add an explanatory tooltip: "Diff colors are semantic, not success/failure indicators."

yara: added a short mock Figma frame and a Storybook note. design-bot: frame uploaded: https://figma.com/file/uvwx-diff-metrics-dark (yara/diff-metrics-darkpass)

design-bot: Storybook fixture created: story/compact-diff-dark with knobs: Heatmap values (on/off/hover), Heatmap patterns, Customer accent override.

yara: plan of record:
- Adjust --diff-add to #5fd1c4 (cooler add color) and keep --chart-err desaturated (#ff6b6b)
- Add Heatmap settings: Values (off/on/hover) + Patterns (accessibility)
- Numeric overlays: alpha controlled by --heat-overlay-alpha; show on hover or when 'Values' = on
- Add 1px outline for top/bottom deciles as pattern fallback in compact mode
- Ensure keyboard focus and aria announcements for tooltips; add tests to the a11y checklist
- Update settings copy and add tooltip text as above

opal: lgtm. can you include an example diff + chart adjacent in the Storybook fixture so QA can verify visual coherence?

yara: yes, will add a side-by-side story and open a small PR linking Figma + contrast report. pinging @priya for a11y sign-off when tests finish. thanks all :sparkles:
